label.description: Label that identifies the tag in the Salesforce user interface.

name.description: The unique name of the tag. Can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores.

options.description: A list of options associated with the tag.

properties.description: A list of properties associated with the tag.
